dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp high-contrast outer perimeters. The transition from the dark exterior to the light grey interior ring is abrupt, with the most distinct 3 structures showing irregular, jagged outer margins and nearly complete internal enclosures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical, solid light-grey pixel clusters lacking internal gradients is observed primarily along the ventral-lateral boundary and towards the anterior neck region. These form tight, non-overlapping groupings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the central dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle. A series of smaller high-intensity blobs form a roughly linear trajectory following the longitudinal axis ventral to the primary annuli.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A localized cluster of high-intensity magenta and white pixels is visible on the posterior lateral flank, representing a deviation from the natural coat pattern and indicative of a potential lesion or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The texture exhibits a distinct longitudinal gradient where high-contrast annuli and blobs are concentrated on the anterior two-thirds of the body, transitioning into a uniform low-intensity dark region at the caudal extremity.
